THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour which accompanies this order exists between.
Mr. L.J.M.U.B.Jayasundara, No. 22, 4th Step, Uyandana Watta, Kurunegala. and
RN Contructions (Pvt) Ltd, No. 532/1, Kaduwela Road, Thalahena, Battaramulla.

NOW THEREFORE I, Dr. Anil Jayantha Fernando, Minister of Labour do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint.
Mr. Bandara Senarath, Attorney-at-Law, No. 331/3, New Hunupitiya Road, Dalugama Kiribathgoda
to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
Dr. ANIL JAYANTHA FERNANDO, Minister of Labour.Colombo.25th March 2025,

Mr. L.J.M.U.B.Jayasundara, No. 22, 4th Step, Uyandana Watta, Kurunegala. and
RN Contructions (Pvt) Ltd, No. 532/1, Kaduwela Road, Thalahena, Battaramulla.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. L.J.M.U.B.Jayasundara who worked as the Engineer of the Worksite of RN Constructions (Pvt) Ltd from 08.08.2017 to 08.01.2021 had been caused injustice by not being paid the ﬁ xed monthly allowance of Rs. 30,000/ (minimum of Rs. 30,000 to a maximum of Rs. 40,000) for the period from 01.07.2020 to 08.01.2021 in accordance with his appointment letter, and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
H.K.K.A. JAYASUNDARA, Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the ofﬁ ce of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo, on this 28th day of February, 2025.

No. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions) Act No.37 of 1968 dated 23.04.2023 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 2331/18 dated 09.05.2023 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter speciﬁ ed in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labour 04.04.2023.

The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is

Whether Mr. R.Rohit Chaudry and Mr. Rajesh K.Narang who were attached to Sri Lankan Airlines Limited as Captains under a 05 year service agreement had been caused injustice by, being send on compulsary leave from 01.04.2020 to 13.01.2021 and not being paid the salary and any allowances mentioned in the service agreement for that period and if so, to what relief they are entitled.
